احتجموا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَمُوا (iḥtajamū) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# اُحْتُجِمُوا (uḥtujimū) /uħ.tu.d͡ʒi.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# اِحْتَجِمُوا (iḥtajimū) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
